footer.tagline: Making shared living simple, transparent, and fair for everyone.

hero.headline: Know what you owe.
hero.subtitle: House M8 keeps shared expenses, bills and balances current for everyone in the house. Add an expense once; the split, the reminders and who pays whom are done for you.

features.title: Everything you need to manage shared living
features.subtitle: Designed specifically for roommates, partners, and friends living together.

problem.title: Shared houses shouldn't be this complicated
problem.intro: Before House M8, managing shared finances meant spreadsheets, passive-aggression, and a group chat that no one dared scroll back through.

maths.title: The maths never adds up
maths.description: Everyone paid something different and nobody can agree on the total.

groupChat.title: The group chat is not the right tool
groupChat.description: Receipts buried under memes. Debts forgotten. Awkwardness ensured.

latePayments.title: Late payments damage friendships
latePayments.description: One delayed payment becomes a month of tension.

problem.cta: There is a better way. Here is how House M8 handles each of these.

smartSplitting.title: Smart splitting
smartSplitting.description: Split bills by percentage, exact amounts, or shares. Whether someone has a bigger room or eats less pizza, handle the math instantly.

realTimeBalances.title: Real-time balances
realTimeBalances.description: Stop scrolling through group chats. See exactly who owes what instantly with a live dashboard that updates as soon as an expense is added.

recurringBills.title: Recurring bills
recurringBills.description: Set rent, internet, and utilities on autopilot. We'll remind everyone before the due date and automatically add it to the ledger.

bulletinBoard.title: Bulletin board
bulletinBoard.description: Keep house announcements, chore lists, and wifi passwords in one central place. No more sticky notes on the fridge.

reporting.title: Issue reporting
reporting.description: Report household issues like leaks, electrical problems, or broken appliances. Attach photos and get them tracked until resolved.

maintenance.title: Maintenance tracking
maintenance.description: Submit repair requests with descriptions and photos. Track open issues and see when they are marked as solved.

resolution.title: Resolution workflow
resolution.description: Issues stay open until explicitly resolved. Owners and housemates share the same view so nothing falls through the cracks.

ownerContact.title: Direct owner contact
ownerContact.description: Report maintenance issues, billing problems, or contract concerns directly to property owners. Streamlined communication for faster resolutions.

seo.title: House M8 - Manage shared living expenses
seo.description: Track expenses, split bills instantly, and manage every shared-house task in one place.

cta.title: Ready to make roommate life easier?
cta.subtitle: Stop arguing about money. Track every expense, split bills fairly, and see live balances — all in one place built for shared living.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get your household up and running in minutes. No complex setup required.

createHouse.title: Create a house
createHouse.description: Sign up and name your household. It's your new digital home base.

inviteRoommates.title: Invite roommates
inviteRoommates.description: Send a simple link to your roommates. They join, and you're all connected.

addExpenses.title: Add expenses
addExpenses.description: Snap a photo of a receipt or type in an expense. We handle the math.

settleUp.title: Pay back
settleUp.description: Record a payment when you pay someone back. Balances update instantly for everyone in the house.

free.question: Is House M8 really free?
free.answer: Yes. The core features are free forever with no credit card required. Create a house, invite your roommates, and start splitting expenses immediately at no cost.

invite.question: How do I invite my roommates?
invite.answer: Create your house, go to Settings → Members, and share the invite link. Your roommates click the link and are in — no lengthy sign-up process required.

currencies.question: What currencies are supported?
currencies.answer: EUR and USD are supported. Each expense can be logged in either currency, and balances are shown in your preferred currency automatically.

solo.question: Can I use it without my roommates signing up?
solo.answer: Yes. You can track expenses solo and invite others when ready. Pending members appear as placeholders until they accept the invitation.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Yes. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We use JWT authentication and never share your data with third parties. Your financial information stays private.

multipleHouses.question: Can I manage multiple houses?
multipleHouses.answer: Yes. The Pro plan supports up to 3 houses from one account. The House+ plan removes that limit entirely. Switch between houses instantly from the dashboard with all data kept fully separate.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when your house is ready.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.whatBody: Cookies are small text files that a website stores on your device. Similar technologies, such as local storage and session storage, work in the same way. This policy covers both and refers to them together as "cookies".
cookiePolicy.usedIntro: House M8 only uses technical cookies and preference storage, all set by House M8 itself (first party). We do not use analytics, advertising or profiling cookies, and we do not load third-party trackers.

table.caption: Cookies and browser storage used by House M8
table.name: Name

cookiePolicy.noConsentTitle: Why there is no cookie banner
cookiePolicy.noConsentBody: Technical cookies, and preference choices you make yourself (language, theme), do not require your prior consent. This follows article 122 of the Italian Privacy Code (Legislative Decree 196/2003) and the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante) guidelines on cookies of 10 June 2021. If we ever add cookies that need consent, we will ask for it first and update this page.
cookiePolicy.thirdPartyBody: If you sign in with Google, you are redirected to the Google website. Google may set its own cookies on its own domain, under its own policy; House M8 does not control it.
cookiePolicy.manageTitle: How to delete or block cookies
cookiePolicy.manageBody: You can delete or block cookies from your browser settings. Blocking necessary cookies will prevent you from signing in. Official instructions:
cookiePolicy.clearBody: Your language and theme choices are stored only in your browser, and the language only once you have picked one. Deleting the site data for House M8 in your browser removes them, and the defaults apply again.
cookiePolicy.contactBody: For questions about this policy, {email}. See also the {privacyLink}.
cookiePolicy.contactFallback: use the privacy settings in the app
cookiePolicy.localeNote: The language cookie (i18n_locale) is set only when you pick a language with the language switcher. Until then, no cookie is set for your language.
